description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from exile to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Hero of the Dunes trigger, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 one additional time.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.
